title: Grazing of Cattle in the Protected Forests Range Lands Rules 1978

sections.shortTitle: Grazing of Cattle in the Protected Forests Range Lands Rules 1978
sections.section: RULE - Grazing of Cattle in the Protected Forests (Range Lands) Rules 1978
sections.description:
GRAZING OF CATTLE IN THE PROTECTED FORESTS
GRAZING OF CATTLE
IN THE PROTECTED FORESTS
(RANGE LANDS)
RULES, 1978
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, Part I, 28th February 1979]
No. S.O. Ft. (Ext.)
IV-5/78.-------In exercise of the powers conferred by section 32 read with
section 76 of the Forest Act, 1927 (XVI of 1927) and in supersession of all
previous orders on the subject, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make
the following rules to regulate the grazing of cattle in Protected Forests
(Range Land) :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(i) These rules may be called the Grazing in the Protected
Forests (Range Lands) Rules, 1978.
(ii) They shall apply to such
Protected Forests (Range Lands) in the Punjab as may be notified by the
Government from time to time.
(iii) They shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.----Unless
the subject or the context otherwise requires the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby assigned to them namely :--
(a) "Authority" means
the Division I Forest Officer of the area concerned.
(b) "Authorised
Officer" means any person appointed by the Authority to carry out all or
any of the purposes of these rules.
(c) "Form" means a form
appended to rules.
(d) "Grazing year"
means the year from 1st July to 30th June.
(e) "Grazing Programme"
means a Programme prepared and announced by the Authority to regulate grazing
in the Protected Forests (Range Lands).
(f) "Licence" means a
permit issued under the Rules.
(g) "Licensee" means a
person holding a Licence under the rules and shall include his agent
accompanying the cattle in the grazing area, and
(h) "Registered
grazier" means a grazier registered under the rules.
3. Registration.-(i) Every
grazier interested to graze his cattle in the Protected Forests (Range Lands)
shall apply to the Authority in Form 'A' for his registration.
(ii) On the receipt of the
application, the Authority may register the grazier for a period of one year on
payment of Rs. 10 as registration fee. The registration, may be renewed every
year on payment of a fee of Rs. 5.
4. Licences.---On a
request in writing by a registered grazier a non transferable licence in Form
B' may be issued by the Authorised Officer for a period of three months or part
thereof on payment of such grazing fee as tray be prescribed by the Government from
time to time.
5. Receipts.---The
Authorized Officer shall issue a receipt for all pay ments made under the
rules.
6. Grazing Programme.----Notwithstanding
anything contained in any agreement, custom or usage :-
(i) The authority may from time
to time declare any Protected Forests (Range Lands) as open to grazing.
(ii) To regulate the grazing in
such areas the Authority may from time to time announce the grazing programme
and pass such orders as it deems necessary.
7. Refusal to grant
registration or licence.-----The Authority shall not register any person as
grazier :-
If there are reasons to believe
that he has been responsible for or has been responsible for or has been
concerned in any such subversive activities, as setting to a forest, creating
dissatisfaction amongst the public or the graziers, indulges in acts prohibited
under these rules or any law for the time being in force or he is in the habit
of committing forest offences.
8. Unauthorised Grazing of
cattle.-All Cattle-
(a) found in closed area;
(b) found grazing in the grazing
area without a licence or in violation of the terms of licence or that of the
grazing programme;
(c) found grazing in the grazing
`area between one hour after the sunset or one hour before the sunrise, shall
be deemed as trespassing and shall be dealt with under the Forest Act, 1927
provided the Authority may also cancel the licence.
9. Carrying of cutting
instruments etc.---The licensee shall not carry any cutting instrument in
grazing area and shall not lop or injure any trees or bushes in any manner
except with the permission in writing of the Authority.
10. Cancellation. of
registration and licence.
